export_evidence: No shipment row could be read. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/v-guard-industries-ltd loaded only a gated shell: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world" — 0 shipment rows visible (counter says data exists back to 2008, but no date/destination/HS/B-L line was rendered). Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/v-guard-industries/export/export-from-india/), Eximpedia and Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge. No bill-of-lading number, date or destination obtained from any source.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated P&L (https://www.screener.in/company/VGUARD/consolidated/), exact line: "Sales + 1,731 1,845 2,086 2,326 2,594 2,503 2,721 3,500 4,127 4,857 5,578 5,966 6,822" (Rs crore, FY2015–FY2026 consolidated) and latest quarter "Sales Qtr Rs.Cr. 1852.89"; company profile line: "V-Guard is a Kochi based company, founded in 1977 ... manufacturing Voltage stabilizers, Digital UPS systems & Batteries, Pumps, House wiring cables, Switch gears, Modular switches, Electric water heaters, Fans, Solar water heaters, Air coolers and various Kitchen appliances"; 16 manufacturing plants and 100,000 retail outlets (Mar 2026). This is audited domestic turnover, i.e. real domestic supply activity — not a catalogue claim.
note: Listed Indian manufacturer (BSE 532953 / NSE VGUARD), 16 plants, FY2026 consolidated sales Rs 6,822 Cr — the entity exists and clearly supplies the domestic market (domestic_status confirmed on audited turnover). Export side could not be verified: every trade-data source was paywalled or blocked (ImportKey gated with 0 rows, Volza/Eximpedia/Trademo 403, ImportGenius JS challenge), so export_status is 'unknown', not 'none_found' — absence of accessible records is not evidence of absence. No export share, destination or HS-level split was public in the sources reachable; export revenue figure left null rather than estimated. Declared HS 853810 (parts for switchgear/control panels) is narrower than the company's actual mix (stabilizers, cables, pumps, appliances, fans); HS not corrected here because no customs line was readable — flag for HS review against actual product mix, not a rejection ground per rule 3. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed (out of scope for this role).
